principle: Keep the catalog small. The manager/model chooses the smallest relevant semantic capability from metadata; deterministic runtime resolves an exact contract id to exactly one pack and enforces execution boundaries without keyword-routing literary meaning.

packs.description: Manager pre-independent candidate self-audit, Blind Reader experience, semantic hard-rule audit, independent production review, pairwise comparison, character integrity and semantic revision diagnosis.
packs.load_when: The task needs post-generation candidate qualification, a natural reader signal, explicit semantic hard-rule compliance, character/repair diagnosis, candidate comparison, or an independent production-quality gate.

packs.description: Source-bound long-horizon narrative interpretation, reader-expectation interpretation, and derived-memory consolidation.
packs.load_when: The task needs long-form derived narrative state, live reader expectations, or compact rebuildable memory.

packs.description: Rights-safe craft and model-classified prose-style observation, scene-aware per-work synthesis, bounded axis claim discovery and source-free dynamic-cohort reconciliation, held-out semantic verification, eight-dimension anonymous prose review plus independent leakage and public-abstraction provenance gates, and run-scoped user-taste relevance selection without automatic promotion authority.
packs.load_when: The task must analyze learning evidence, classify or synthesize anonymous prose-style operations, reconcile bounded axis claims while selecting the next minimum eligible opaque work cohort, verify a style claim on held-out profiles, compare frozen anonymous prose samples, inspect a candidate for semantic leakage against anonymous references, review fingerprint-only provenance for a public abstraction, decide whether a preference/craft hypothesis is semantically supported at a proposed scope, independently evaluate a learned mechanism, or select relevant active user-taste guidance for one frozen run.

packs.description: Agent-owned context selection, semantic profile derivation and stage-specific activation under deterministic lifecycle, authority, fingerprint, capability and budget guards.
packs.load_when: The task must derive retrieval metadata, select stage-specific context from an eligible candidate universe, decide what context is needed, continue/reformulate search, or plan evidence discovery.

packs.description: Goal- and knowledge-bounded character action simulation followed by scene-level collision/world-state resolution and causal event trajectory proposals.
packs.load_when: The task is pre-draft scene simulation, character agency simulation, or repair of a flat/forced scene through causal character/world interactions.

packs.description: Automatic feedback-candidate interpretation, writer-safe causal projection with optional outline-driven craft selection, and FIX+PRESERVE Editor repair planning.
packs.load_when: The production loop must interpret feedback, project private simulation into writer-safe causal context (selecting methods from an explicitly supplied frozen catalog when enabled), or plan a repair that preserves current higher-order objectives.

packs.description: Dynamic active-plan reconciliation, evidence-based relationship-memory reconciliation, and explicit narrative-commitment auditing for long-horizon coherence.
packs.load_when: The task must adapt a plan after causal emergence, reconcile conflicting long-lived relationship memories, or verify a candidate against explicit long-term commitments/facts.

packs.description: Causally divergent scenario exploration, objective-preserving repair comparison, and neutral anonymous A/B semantic-ablation comparison without granting simplification authority.
packs.load_when: The workflow needs materially distinct scenario forks, must verify targeted repair improvement without higher-order objective regression, or needs an independent neutral comparison of two anonymous semantic-ablation condition results.
